pages.lesson:
LESSON: WRITING 5.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING – NARRATIVE COMPOSITION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we narrate events?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the features of a narrative composition
2. write a narrative composition for self- expression

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 5.3.1 CREATIVE WRITING – NARRATIVE COMPOSITION
This lesson teaches Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition for Grade 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the features of a narrative composition
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write a narrative composition for self- expression
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition above.
2. Explain Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 5.3.1 Creative writing – Narrative composition important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we narrate events?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the features of a narrative composition
2. write a narrative composition for self- expression

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
